reading.body:
Sam Liccardo's AI record mixes grid and energy bills with money from the largest AI companies, and the two run on the same calendar.

The legislative side is not only about models. Two of the cosponsorships, H.R. 7696 and H.R. 7697, both dated 2026-02-25, address cyber protection of the grid and international AI energy grid modernization. That is the compute and power layer showing up in bill titles, not just data center siting or model safety. The remaining items cover adversarial threats, deepfake labeling, financial services and housing uses, AI education, and the CREATE AI Act.

The money is concentrated and repeated. Google's NetPAC gave three times, $1,000 in March 2025, $1,000 in March 2026, and $3,000 in May 2026. Microsoft's PAC gave twice, $1,000 in April 2025 and $1,500 in June 2026. Meta's PAC gave twice, $1,000 in December 2025 and $2,000 in June 2026. Amazon gave $2,500 in June 2026. All eight contributions fall between April 2025 and June 2026, and the four largest arrive in the last four months of that window.

What this does not show is causation. The page states plainly that date order is not a claim that one event caused another, and nothing here establishes that any contribution was tied to any vote or cosponsorship. It also does not cover the content of the bills, only their titles and status dates, and it does not include contributions below the itemized threshold or any spending that went to other candidates. The record is a sequence, not an argument.

summary: Every dated AI event this site holds for Sam Liccardo: bills sponsored or cosponsored, recorded votes on AI bills, and money from AI company and AI-focused political committees, newest first. 19 events.
